test_vector_casting: test the pybind11 STL vector casting between std::vector and Python list types
test_map_casting: test the pybind11 STL map casting between std::map and Python dict types
test_optional_handling: test the pybind11 optional type handling with None and default value support
test_recursive_casting: test the pybind11 STL recursive casting preserving lvalue and rvalue context
test_variant_casting: test the pybind11 variant type casting between std::variant and Python Union types
